import json, pathlib, subprocess, tempfile, textwrap; repo = pathlib.Path.cwd(); fz = repo / 'target/debug/fz'
root = pathlib.Path(tempfile.mkdtemp(prefix='fozzylang-release-policy-'))
(root / 'src').mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
(root / 'fozzy.toml').write_text(textwrap.dedent('''\
[package]
name="release_policy"
version="0.1.0"

[[target.bin]]
name="release_policy"
path="src/main.fzy"
'''))
(root / 'src/main.fzy').write_text('fn main() -> i32 {\n    return 0\n}\n')
bench = root / 'bench.json'
bench.write_text(json.dumps({'benches': [
    {'bench': 'cli_startup', 'ratio_fzy_over_rust': 1.1},
    {'bench': 'http_throughput', 'ratio_fzy_over_rust': 0.9},
    {'bench': 'compiler_parse_lower_build', 'ratio_fzy_over_rust': 1.6}
]}))
build_proc = subprocess.run([str(fz), 'build', str(root), '--json'], cwd=str(repo), capture_output=True, text=True)
build_payload = json.loads(build_proc.stdout.strip())
assert build_proc.returncode == 0, (build_proc.returncode, build_payload, build_proc.stderr)
assert build_payload['status'] == 'ok', build_payload
policy = json.loads((root / '.fz' / 'release-policy.json').read_text())
assert policy['schemaVersion'] == 'fozzylang.release_policy.v1', policy
assert policy['versions']['traceSchemaVersion'] == 'fozzy-trace.v4', policy
assert policy['versions']['manifestSchemaVersion'] == 'fozzy.run_manifest.v1', policy
assert policy['versions']['runtimeAbiVersion'] == 'fozzylang.runtime.v0', policy
assert policy['versions']['nativeImportTableVersion'] == 'fozzylang.native_runtime_contracts.v1', policy
assert policy['errorModel']['serviceFunctionsReturn'] == 'Result<T, Error>', policy
assert any(item['name'] == 'timeout' for item in policy['errorModel']['errorClasses']), policy
assert any(item['name'] == 'compiler_parse_lower_build' for item in policy['performance']['workloads']), policy
assert any(item['name'] == 'diagnostic-catalog' for item in policy['documentation']['surfaces']), policy
policy_md = (root / '.fz' / 'release-policy.md').read_text()
assert '## Compatibility' in policy_md, policy_md
assert '## Benchmark Lanes' in policy_md, policy_md
perf_proc = subprocess.run([str(fz), 'perf', '--artifact', str(bench), '--json'], cwd=str(repo), capture_output=True, text=True)
perf_payload = json.loads(perf_proc.stdout.strip())
assert perf_proc.returncode == 0, (perf_proc.returncode, perf_payload, perf_proc.stderr)
assert perf_payload['benchCount'] == 3, perf_payload
assert perf_payload['worstKernel'] == 'compiler_parse_lower_build', perf_payload
dash_proc = subprocess.run([str(fz), 'stability-dashboard', '--json'], cwd=str(repo), capture_output=True, text=True)
dash_payload = json.loads(dash_proc.stdout.strip())
assert dash_proc.returncode == 0, (dash_proc.returncode, dash_payload, dash_proc.stderr)
assert dash_payload['dashboard']['compatibility']['traceSchemaVersion'] == 'fozzy-trace.v4', dash_payload
assert any(item['name'] == 'cli_startup' for item in dash_payload['dashboard']['performance']['workloads']), dash_payload
print('compiler-release-policy-ok')
